text.content:
Neon, dollhouses, braindance parlors and noodle bars.

Region: Japantown, Westbrook (#10)
Controlled by: The Tyger Claws, with a Mox toehold
The feel of it: The Claws' money street; sex, drugs and protection money
Notable locations: Clouds (#12) in H8, the Moon Garden, Wakako Okada's pachinko parlor
Danger: SC 7: Tyger Claws, Hardened Light

Claw bikers patrol the street and their lanterns hang outside every shop that pays; the Red Lanterns hang them, and the G4 paint over them. Every dollhouse here has a Mox doorman or a Mox friend. In 2070 Shinobu the Third closed two Claw dollhouses on the street. Doc Mags advises against the ripperdoc here.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.03, 04, 09
